title: Tech Note: Native Webcam Support and Integration
author: Add Komoncharoensiri, Director of Technical Services, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Still relevant: native webcam access via the embedded Web Area rendering engine and getUserMedia remains the current technique in 4D; it superseded the older 2015-era external-framework approach referenced in the note itself.
related_updates: Directly supersedes 4D's own 2015 Tech Note that needed third-party frameworks for camera access — this v19R3 approach via the embedded Chromium-based Web Area engine and HTML5 getUserMedia is the durable modern replacement and remains valid today.
The Web Area's embedded rendering engine has continued to be updated/maintained by 4D, so HTML5 camera APIs used here should still function on current 4D versions.
